subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale exact-pin assertions are repaired, should the security workflow owner approve this grouped privileged-action update or require it to be split?
rationale: Source review verifies official provenance and mechanical guard defects, but the protected security label and credentialed workflow scope require explicit owner authorization.

options.title: Repair and approve rollup
options.body: Update all four assertions, rerun focused validation, and approve the verified official action set as one coordinated maintenance change.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token-minting, Codex, release, or security-scanning action updates for narrower approval and rollout.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve rollup
recommendation.body: Update all four assertions, rerun focused validation, and approve the verified official action set as one coordinated maintenance change.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly owns the most security-sensitive changed workflows and guards.
